changes.u64_combine: Extend the compiler-private exact scratch-array matcher to two u64 lanes; emit scalar ADDP Dtmp,Vsource.2d, UMOV Xtmp,Vtmp.d[0], then scalar seed addition. Preserve the source vector and original rewritten AST verifier reference.
changes.scalar_addp_semantics: Only the two-operand D/2D form acquires checker semantics: read both halves before writing, wrapping u64 addition, zero upper destination half. Other vector/SVE forms remain unsupported by this rule. No proof-admission relaxation.
changes.leaf_homes: Prefer the existing optional leafVectorPool before callee-saved vector homes. Incoming float/vector arguments and v0 remain excluded; release, clobber, calling-function, RV64, and frame-layout policies are unchanged.
changes.ordering_projection: New MemoryEventProjection Lean module conditionally preserves exact read/EA/data request triples, payloads, acknowledgements, absolute positions, multiplicity, and concatenation. The raw adapter/provenance and expected-call list are supplied premises, not generated Arm traces.

static_observations_not_performance_resu.method: Count instruction lines within each named function in final runner disassembly, including all paths. Not dynamic counts or cycles; zero-frame bodies contain no SP movement or frame accesses.
static_observations_not_performance_resu.note: Both Oak reductions now avoid scratch-array traffic and callee-saved vector saves/restores. Changes were validated together; these counts do not isolate a runtime speedup or establish plus-or-minus8-percent parity.

proof_boundaries: The native checker extension is grounded by exact pinned Sail declarations and hardware differentials, not a new kernel-checked ADDP/ASL refinement or proof of FP/AdvSIMD enable checks.
MemoryEventProjection consumes a supplied observation adapter and trace. It does not prove original-model trace production, adapter soundness, full-state correspondence, or architectural commitment.

Selector/payload types are abstract; no initialization, width, byte-count or defined-bit facts are implicit. Structural projection accepts false acknowledgements; SuccessfulReplay is an explicit stronger caller-supplied contract.

CAT W/TTD classification, coherence, translation/cacheability, invalidation scope, Lean/Lem tag-state refinement and publication remain open. No optimizer reordering permission follows from the new theorem.
